message.content: In the community discussion, the addition of some outdoor games or a small water feature was proposed. Specifically, Arthas Menethil expressed enthusiasm for adding a water feature, stating, "A nice spot to enjoy the flowers and herbs would be amazing. Maybe some benches or chairs around? 😊" He then went on to suggest a fountain, which he believed would add a nice touch to the garden and enhance its overall feel. Additionally, the proposal of a small water feature aligns with the suggestion made by Chae Song-hwa, who commented, "A water feature sounds lovely! It could be a nice focal point and bring some tranquility to the space." Both comments highlight the desire to incorporate soothing elements like water features and engaging activities like outdoor games to create a comprehensive and enjoyable play area for the children.
